senses.gloss: m. (= תרתור׳; cmp. שַׁרְשֶׁרֶת, שָׁרִיתָא; cmp. גִּשְׁרָא) bridge (Assyr. titurru).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 21a:9">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ואי איכא ת׳ ממטינן וכ׳</he> if there is a bridge, we may let the children cross the river (to attend school on the other side), but if there is only a cross-board (<he>גַּמְלָא</he> I) &c.

Ned. 41ᵃ מטא ת׳ וכ׳ when he came to a bridge, the animal shied.—Trnsf. ת׳ דתפלין the skin drawn over the capsule of the T’fillin of the arm after the inscriptions have been put in, bottom of the capsule with a hollow rim (מעברתא).
